    <title>v16.5.0-canary.16</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Core Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>Refactor fetchStrategy -&gt; stage and completeness: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5718739537" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/99706" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/99706/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/99706">#99706</a></li>
<li>Remove dead NextNodeServer.renderHTML: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5875997367" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100284" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100284/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100284">#100284</a></li>
<li>Pass Server Action request metadata into App rendering: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5874060565" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100274" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100274/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100274">#100274</a></li>
<li>Revert "Keep requests through middleware in a single OpenTelemetry trace": <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5881513471" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100302" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100302/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100302">#100302</a></li>
<li>Respect release age when pinning the upgrade CLI: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5868556480" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100256" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100256/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100256">#100256</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Misc Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>test: remove stale deploy gate on cold RSC navigation param caching test: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5876687682" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100285" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100285/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100285">#100285</a></li>
<li>Fix upgrade eval worktree dependency links: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5869091370" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100257" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100257/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100257">#100257</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Credits</h3>
<p>Huge thanks to <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/lukesandberg/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/lukesandberg">@lukesandberg</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/acdlite/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/acdlite">@acdlite</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/kassens/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/kassens">@kassens</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/devjiwonchoi/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/devjiwonchoi">@devjiwonchoi</a>, and <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/sokra/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/sokra">@sokra</a> for helping!</p></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/70107786/v16.5.0-canary.15</id>
    <updated>2026-10-15T23:44:24Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/releases/tag/v16.5.0-canary.15"/>
    <title>v16.5.0-canary.15</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Core Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>Hoist app page request URL into render context: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5589741005" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/99269" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/99269/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/99269">#99269</a></li>
<li>Hide overlay editor button labels on smaller screens: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5872191022" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100266" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100266/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100266">#100266</a></li>
<li>Prefer non-partial entries regardless of FetchStrategy: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5718738596" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/99705" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/99705/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/99705">#99705</a></li>
<li>[Partial Prefetching] Don't report vary params in responses that include dynamic data: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5717092222" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/99700" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/99700/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/99700">#99700</a></li>
<li>[Partial Prefetching] Small optimizations and fixes: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5716084619" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/99695" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/99695/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/99695">#99695</a></li>
<li>[Cached Navs] Extract the shell from a fully cached response: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5685420076" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/99619" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/99619/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/99619">#99619</a></li>
<li>Refactor the navigation fetch and decode layering: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5685419618" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/99618" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/99618/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/99618">#99618</a></li>
<li>[Cached Navs] Don't extract static stage: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5685419155" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/99617" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/99617/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/99617">#99617</a></li>
<li>Make error overlay editor actions easier to discover: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5855766749" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100206" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100206/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100206">#100206</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Misc Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>Turbopack: don't inherit API route config from parent layouts: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5864556224" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100243" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100243/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100243">#100243</a></li>
<li>test: Add more segment config tests: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5864554698" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100242" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100242/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100242">#100242</a></li>
<li>Add more test coverage for non-Partial Prefetching behavior: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5831728012" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100133" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100133/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100133">#100133</a></li>
<li>chore: Remove package.json#workspaces: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5863656000" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100234" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100234/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100234">#100234</a></li>
<li>docs: Add Pages Router upgrade guides for versions 15 and 16: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5866420134" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100247" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100247/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100247">#100247</a></li>
<li>docs: note that 'use cache: private' results persist across requests in dev: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5867421568" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100252" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100252/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100252">#100252</a></li>
<li>test: unskip tests for Turbopack: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5849121987" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100185" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100185/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100185">#100185</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Credits</h3>
<p>Huge thanks to <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/gnoff/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/gnoff">@gnoff</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/samselikoff/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/samselikoff">@samselikoff</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/mischnic/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/mischnic">@mischnic</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/acdlite/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/acdlite">@acdlite</a>, and <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/icyJoseph/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/icyJoseph">@icyJoseph</a> for helping!</p></content>

    <title>v16.5.0-canary.13</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Core Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>Fix extensionless Google font URLs in both bundlers: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5842249865" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100158" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100158/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100158">#100158</a></li>
<li>Emit the Turbopack shared-runtime bootstrap in the PPR resume so it gets the CSP nonce: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5826358930" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100102" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100102/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100102">#100102</a></li>
<li>Keep requests through middleware in a single OpenTelemetry trace: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5833443288" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100136" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100136/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100136">#100136</a></li>
<li>Write webpack dev manifests atomically: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5827135217" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100112" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100112/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100112">#100112</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Misc Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>next-api: isolate dropped entrypoint collectibles in an inner operation: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5850640204" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100187" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100187/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100187">#100187</a></li>
<li>turbo-tasks-backend: optimize aggregated updates outside of the lock: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5844247307" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100165" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100165/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100165">#100165</a></li>
<li>docs: Add turborepo agents rules: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5856750744" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/100214" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/100214/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/100214">#100214</a></li>
